def_en: 1) a team, chariot, chariotry, mill-stone, riders
1c) upper millstone (as riding on lower millstone)
1d) riders, troop (of riders), horsemen, pair of horsemen, men riding, ass-riders, camel-riders
kjv: chariot, (upper) millstone, multitude (from the margin), wagon.
expl: a vehicle; by implication, a team; by extension, cavalry; by analogy a rider, i.e. the upper millstone
